newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Nat Gas interested in rest of Waikato gas.
newsitem.headline: Nat Gas interested in rest of Waikato gas.

text.p: Natural Gas Corp said on Tuesday that it was interested in buying the rest of Natural Gas Waikato now that the Hamilton City Council had offered its 30 percent stake for sale.
Natural Gas Corp Holdings Ltd owns 70 percent of Natural Gas Waikato.
Natural Gas said in a statement it had pre-emptive rights to the shares held by the council, but had not received formal advice from the council of its intention to divest its shareholding.

"Natural Gas Corporation would be interested in acquiring the council's shares, subject to receipt of formal advice of their sale and to the satisfactory outcome of necessary negotiations," Natural Gas said.
